title: AAPCS64 Reserved for indirect return value addresses X8
summary: For aggregate results returned through memory, the caller provides the storage and passes its address in X8.
applies: AArch64; general call and register representation of AAPCS64
detail: X8 in the entry snapshot can represent the result buffer. Ordinary user parameters are still classified starting from the corresponding parameter register.
boundary: Small structures or homogeneous floating-point aggregates may be returned directly through registers, and this rule does not apply.
relevance: Avoid adding an explicit source code parameter out of thin air when restoring a function prototype.
